default_queue.description: Service Bus queue for tasks without an explicit queue.

default_task_timeout_s.description: Default timeout in seconds for tasks without an explicit timeout. Null (the default) disables stuck-task detection unless an explicit per-task timeout_s is set.

tasks.description: List of tasks forming the DAG.

name.description: Unique task name within the workflow.

kwargs.description: Keyword arguments passed to the task processor.

depends_on.description: Names of tasks that must complete before this task runs.

queue.description: Service Bus queue to route this task to (overrides default_queue).

dep_policy.description: When to run: 'all' (all deps succeed), 'any' (at least one), 'all_settled' (wait for all to finish, then run iff at least one succeeded), or N (at least N succeed).

num_retries.description: Number of retry attempts on failure.

condition.description: Expression evaluated against upstream outputs to decide whether to run or skip this task. Example: inputs["train"].loss < 0.01
